judgment_calls.decision: Possible TB diagnosis from cough, weight decreased, night sweats, fever or TB contact; check_for task and Urgent priority both keyed on (diagnosis Tuberculosis possible).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Trigger the task directly on the symptoms; would duplicate logic and not reflect "suspected TB".

judgment_calls.topic: Test without symptoms (DS-TB in last 2 years, PLHIV schedule, abnormal CXR+CAD)
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: yearly/at-diagnosis schedules and CXR CAD results cannot be expressed; only TB contact is encoded.
judgment_calls.alternatives: History of tuberculosis or HIV as possible-TB triggers, which would fire at every visit.

judgment_calls.topic: Lab-driven diagnoses (urine LAM, TB NAAT, DST → DS-TB, INH-resistant TB, RR-TB)
judgment_calls.decision: No probable rules: evidence is lab results with no representation and no SNOMED result findings found.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Probable rules on RR-TB/INH-resistant TB disorders as self-evidence (circular).
